evidence: This is supported by citations to previous research.

claim: A whole transcriptome RNA-seq analysis of OBs isolated from PLX5622-treated and their respective control mice revealed a total of 131 genes were differentially regulated in the PLX5622 mice.
source: The microglial depletion was also evident in the transcriptional level, as revealed by a whole transcriptome RNA-seq analysis of OBs isolated from PLX5622-treated and their respective control mice. A total of 131 genes were differentially regulated in the PLX5622 mice, of which 127 genes were down-regulated (p<0.01, with a cutoff of ±1.35 fold change, Supplementary file 1).
evidence: This is a finding from the RNA-seq analysis.

claim: 127 genes were down-regulated in PLX5622-treated mice (p<0.01, with a cutoff of ±1.35 fold change).

claim: The average length of dendrites per cell was comparable between PLX5622-treated and control mice.
